title: Transitivity of the subtree relation
statement: Let $s$, $t$, and $u$ be binary trees with node labels in a type $\alpha$. If $s$ is a subtree of $t$ and $t$ is a subtree of $u$, then $s$ is a subtree of $u$.
hypotheses_covered: s is a subtree of t
t is a subtree of u
replaced:
If $s$ is a subtree of $t$ and $t$ is a subtree of $u$, then $s$ is a subtree of $u$.
That is, \texttt{TreeIsSubtree} is transitive.
